{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse, relaxed fit with a subtle sheen, knee length, #F5F5DC, smooth satin fabric.
Charcoal grey wool-blend tailored trousers, straight leg cut with a high waistline, full length, #36454F, structured wool fabric.
Nude leather pointed-toe pumps, classic stiletto heel, ankle height, #E0C097, polished calfskin leather.
Silver geometric pendant necklace on an 18-inch chain, medium thickness, #C0C0C0, sterling silver metal.

This outfit meets the formal dress code required for a bank analytics interview while strictly adhering to her refusal of black clothing and heels. The cream blouse provides a professional yet approachable base that contrasts elegantly with the sophisticated grey trousers, creating a polished look suitable for autumn weather. The nude pumps elongate the legs without drawing unnecessary attention, allowing the focus to remain on her presentation and credentials during the meeting."}
